name: Intent Classification and Out-of-Scope Prediction Dataset
description: A dataset designed to evaluate task-oriented dialog systems on intent classification including out-of-scope queries that do not belong to any supported intent class, covering 150 intent classes over 10 domains. It challenges models to identify queries outside the system's supported intents, addressing a gap in realistic benchmarking for text classification in dialog systems.
reputation: Widely used as a standard benchmark for intent classification with out-of-scope detection in task-oriented dialog systems, especially for evaluating realistic deployment robustness.
notes: Includes out-of-scope queries to realistically benchmark task-oriented dialog systems' ability to detect unsupported intents.
